name: ttm
description: Notee pages, workspaces and Factory projects of toantranmei.com for Claude Desktop.
long_description: Runs the open-source ttm-mcp server locally. Sign in once with `ttm login`, or paste a personal access token created at https://toantranmei.com/me/ket-noi.

tools.name: workspace-get-self
tools.description: The signed-in user and the current workspace

token.title: Access token
token.description: Personal access token (ttm_pat_…) from https://toantranmei.com/me/ket-noi. Leave empty to use the token saved by `ttm login`.

host.title: Server
host.description: Server URL. Leave the default unless you use another host.
